sloka: यथा हि अनुदका नद्यो यथा वा अपि अतृणम् वनम् ।अगोपाला यथा गावः तथा राष्ट्रम् अराजकम् ॥२-६७-२९॥
transliteration: yathā hi anudakā nadyo yathā vā api atṛṇam vanam ।agopālā yathā gāvaḥ tathā rāṣṭram arājakam ॥2-67-29॥

translations.english: (The kingdom without a king) is like rivers without water, forests without vegetation and cows without cowherds.
